👉VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Doston, Bharat aaj cricket ki duniya ka badshaah mana jaata hai. Aaj Board of Control for Cricket in India sirf ek cricket board nahi, balki world cricket ki sabse powerful body ban chuka hai. Lekin kya aapko pata hai ki ek waqt aisa bhi tha jab hum itne gareeb aur kamzor the ki Indian players ko bina kisi wajah ke insult kiya jaata tha? Ek taraf jahan English cricketers luxury planes se travel karte the, wahin Indian players ko international tours ke liye cargo ships mein bheja jaata tha. Jab hamare players England tour par jaate the, tab unhe sirf ₹13 milte the, aur isi chhoti si amount mein unhe England mein laundry, travel, khana-peena sab kuch manage karna padta tha.
Jahan ek taraf England ke players five-star restaurants mein khana khate the, wahin doosri taraf Indian players ke paas kai baar basic expenses ke bhi paise nahi hote the. Lekin phir hua ek aisa chamatkaar jisne cricket ke itihaas ko hi badal diya aur Bharat ko world cricket ka champion bana diya. Dheere-dheere Indian cricket ne sirf field par hi nahi, balki business aur governance ke level par bhi apni taqat dikhani shuru kar di.
Aaj wahi Board of Control for Cricket in India itna ameer hai ki jahan England and Wales Cricket Board, Cricket Australia aur Pakistan Cricket Board milkar lagbhag ₹1,608 crore kamate hain, wahin BCCI akela hi ₹20,686 crore kamata hai. Par sabse bada sawal yeh hai: jab India kabhi itna gareeb tha, toh achanak world cricket ka “badshah” kaise ban gaya? BCCI ne aisi kaunsi business strategy use ki jisse woh world cricket ko dominate kar paaya? Aur Bharat ki is kahani se hum kya seekh sakte hain? Yahi samajhne ki koshish aaj hum karenge.
